before.description: Follow one committed voter-to-non-voter transition in a healthy 4-node cluster while sampling every node's own configuration view and log index, three independent runs.

Only the leader is bootstrapped; the other three start with empty configurations and adopt them through normal replication, so the cluster is the same construction as the extended-window experiment that produced the unexplained sighting.
Before the transition the harness waits until every follower reports itself with a vote and has LastIndex >= 2, so the baseline is uniform and the transition is the only event under observation.
Sampling is every 20ms for ten seconds after the transition is committed on the leader; a node counts as converged at the first sample where its own view shows the demoted peer without a vote.
Three runs in one execution; the transports stay fully connected and healthy throughout, so any lag observed is not caused by a partition.
excluded: No partition, no snapshots, no restarts or crash-recovery, and no client traffic besides the configuration change itself.
The configuration index used for the consistency check is read from the leader after the change returns; the harness does not inspect a follower's log store directly.

prefix.before: Four nodes are created (identity = in-memory transport address), wired fully connected and started; only the first is bootstrapped with the four-voter configuration, so it is the deterministic first leader and the others adopt the configuration through replication. It then calls DemoteVoter(near, prevIndex 0, timeout 10s), waits for the future (which returns when the entry is committed on the leader), records the leader's LastIndex as the configuration index, and polls every node every 20ms for ten seconds: each poll reads that node's GetConfiguration view of the near node's suffrage and its LastIndex. One demotion_view CA_EVENT is emitted per node with converged, converged_ms, stale_observed, stale_max_last_index, the configuration index, index_passed_while_stale, and the node's end state and LastIndex.
